WITH team_averages AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        AVG(w) AS avg_wins,
        AVG((g - l) * 1.0 / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_over_losses
    FROM manager_half
    GROUP BY team_id
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        avg_wins,
        avg_games_minus_losses_over_losses,
        avg_wins - AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS gap_above_mean
    FROM team_averages
)
SELECT
    team_id,
    avg_wins,
    avg_games_minus_losses_over_losses,
    gap_above_mean
FROM scored
WHERE gap_above_mean > 0
ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
